summary: Dry-run planner passes, but future launch readiness is HOLD_FOR_REPAIR: exact runtime package binding matches R2, while the generated Q1 plan drops several R2 training-semantic fields and lacks launch-time price/kernel determinism receipts.

evidence.tests: 7 passed; dry-run module has no HF/network/launch code path
evidence.runtime_binding: Python/package pins exactly match R2 frozen target binding
evidence.launch_hold: Generated plan omits gradient_checkpointing_use_reentrant=false; LoRA bias=none/task_type=CAUSAL_LM; model-load dtype=bfloat16/use_cache=false/prepare-kbit-gradient-checkpointing=true. Device mapping may vary only if explicitly recorded.
evidence.hardware: A10G acceptable primary control; L4 must remain a separately reviewed fallback/arm
evidence.variance: Host OS/driver/CUDA/GPU are intended independent variables, not proof of semantic equivalence; record GPU compute capability, driver/CUDA, torch build, bitsandbytes backend/binary, TF32/determinism flags.
evidence.adapter: Final adapter hash equality across GPU types correctly not required; final hash must still be recorded with finite step loss/LR/grad-norm trace and weight-changed receipt.
evidence.staging: No upload authorized. If later authorized, stage only exact 160-row content-addressed shard with post-stage hash/order verification.
evidence.budget: $0.50/1800s is only a ceiling proposal; launch preflight must bind live quoted rate and HOLD if worst-case timeout cost exceeds cap.

next_action: A: revise protocol/plan to carry omitted R2 semantics, add deterministic environment/kernel receipts and live-rate budget preflight; keep dry-run network-free. Then send exact new head to B. No paid launch.
